correctness.rationale: Nilpotence reduces exactly modulo the finite nilpotent Jacobson radical; uniform samples remain uniform and independent; Artin–Wedderburn yields full matrix blocks. For fixed A rank r, AB restricts uniformly to im A and the nilpotent probability is q^{-r}. Expected kernel size of a random product gives 1-(1-q^{-n})^k for every k>=1. Multiplicativity proves the whole ring formula. Largest-exponential-base asymptotics recursively recover the multiset with multiplicities; the k=2 sharp upper bound is elementary and unique. All cases, quantifiers and boundary rank 0 are addressed. Python exact direct enumeration supports 35 small instances but is not used as infinite proof.
